markdown_sources.note: Read the markdown, never the PDF. Target the Methods and PCA sections only (PDF pp. 7-10 and 14-17). CORRECTED: this paper is NOT evidence about IBEI aggregation. It builds its own separate index using HDI-style min-max, arithmetic and geometric aggregation, and applies PCA only against multicollinearity. The IBEI's own three-stage PCA with Z-score standardisation is documented in the Juknis (printed pp. 63-66 and 93-96), and that is what voids the min-max argument in finding 03 round 1. Do not cite Rinaldi for the IBEI's aggregation function.
Read all 12 markdown files (11 indikator-*.md plus kegiatan-94936.md), roughly 28KB total. Official BPS metadata, already extracted, zero extraction cost. Highest value per token in the workspace.
